note: During the First Temple Period, the Babylonian army broke through the walls of Jerusalem to destroy the city (see Jeremiah 39:2; 2 Kings 25:1). The 9th of Tamuz was originally a fast day, but was moved after the Romans later broke through Jerusalem's walls on the 17th of Tamuz.
